195	export async function streamAiChat(
196	  messages: AiMessage[],
197	  system: string | undefined,
198	  onChunk: (text: string) => void,
199	  signal?: AbortSignal,
200	): Promise<string> {
201	  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}/ai/stream`, {
202	    method: 'POST',
203	    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
204	    body: JSON.stringify({ messages, system }),
205	    signal,
206	  })
207	  if (!res.ok) {
208	    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: `HTTP ${res.status}` }))
209	    throw new Error(data.error || `API error: ${res.status}`)
210	  }
211	  const reader = res.body!.getReader()
212	  const decoder = new TextDecoder()
213	  let buffer = ''
214	  let fullContent = ''
215	
216	  while (true) {
217	    const { done, value } = await reader.read()
218	    if (done) break
219	    buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true })
220	    const parts = buffer.split('\n')
221	    buffer = parts.pop() ?? ''
222	    for (const line of parts) {
223	      const trimmed = line.trim()
224	      if (!trimmed.startsWith('data: ')) continue
225	      try {
226	        const event = JSON.parse(trimmed.slice(6))
227	        if (event.type === 'chunk') {
228	          fullContent += event.content
229	          onChunk(event.content)
230	        } else if (event.type === 'done') {
231	          fullContent = event.content
232	        } else if (event.type === 'error') {
233	          throw new Error(event.error)
234	        }
235	      } catch (e) {
236	        if (e instanceof SyntaxError) continue
237	        throw e
238	      }
239	    }
240	  }
241	  return fullContent
242	}

## Summary: Org Chart Page Implementation in Claude-Hub

Based on my thorough exploration of the claude-hub project, here's a complete breakdown of the Org Chart page implementation:

### 1. **Route & Page Location**
- **Route**: `/org-chart` (defined in `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/claude-hub/client/src/App.tsx:84`)
- **Component**: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/claude-hub/client/src/pages/OrgChart.tsx` (15,441 bytes)
- **Navigation**: Sidebar link at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/claude-hub/client/src/components/Sidebar.tsx:168` under "Strategy" section

### 2. **API Endpoint**
- **Endpoint**: `GET /api/org-chart` (defined in `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/claude-hub/src/server.js:3396`)
- **Authentication**: Rate-limited with `rateLimit('read')`
- **Returns**: `OrgChartData` object with:
  - `nodes`: Array of `OrgChartNode` objects
  - `edges`: Array of reporting relationships
  - `phases`: Array of pipeline phases with agents
  - `stats`: Summary statistics

### 3. **Data Structure**

**OrgChartNode Interface** (from `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/claude-hub/client/src/lib/api.ts:549-561`):
```typescript
interface OrgChartNode {
  id: string                  // Agent filename (e.g., 'rex', 'arya')
  name: string               // Agent display name with emoji
  title: string              // Role title
  model: string              // 'opus' or 'sonnet'
  tools: string              // Comma-separated tools
  description: string        // Agent description
  phase: string | null       // Pipeline phase (SHAPE, VALIDATE, BUILD, etc.)
  phaseLabel: string | null  // Human-readable phase label
  phaseColor: string         // Hex color for phase
  reportsTo: string | null   // Parent agent ID (reporting line)
  tier: string               // 'leadership', 'engineer', 'analyst', 'creative'
}
```

**Agent Roles Configuration** (`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/claude-hub/src/server.js:3372-3394`):
- 20 agents with hierarchical structure
- Two C-level agents with no parent: `rex` (Commander) and `verdict` (Portfolio Decider)
- Multi-level reporting chains (e.g., koda reports to arya, who reports to rex)

**Pipeline Phases** (`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/claude-hub/src/server.js:3333-3370`):
1. **SHAPE** (Orange #f59e0b): Scout, Vex, Sage - Validate ideas
2. **VALIDATE** (Purple #8b5cf6): Atlas, Arya, Riko, Ledger - Market sizing
3. **BUILD** (Blue #3b82f6): Rex, Nova, Koda, Luna, Quill, Vega, Zeph - Production
4. **LAUNCH** (Green #10b981): Echo, Mira, Bolt, Hawk - Distribution
5. **MEASURE** (Cyan #06b6d4): Orbit, Pulse - Metrics
6. **DECIDE** (Red #ef4444): Verdict - Scale/pivot/kill

### 4. **Component Architecture**

**Main Component: `OrgChart.tsx`**
- `AgentCard` sub-component (lines 18-118): Individual agent display with collapsible details
- Two view modes:
  - **Pipeline View**: Agents grouped by pipeline phase in horizontal flow
  - **Hierarchy View**: Tree structure showing reporting relationships

**Key Features:**
- Emoji extraction from agent names (lines 31-32)
- Expandable/collapsible agent trees
- Search filtering with ancestor highlighting
- Model badges (Opus/Sonnet)
- Tier icons (Cpu, BarChart3, Paintbrush, Shield)
- Phase color indicators with glow effect
- Detail panel showing description, tools, and reports-to info
- Expand All/Collapse All buttons for hierarchy view

### 5. **Rendering Logic**

**Hierarchy View** (`renderTree` function, lines 167-221):
- Recursive tree rendering starting from leadership (reportsTo: null)
- Depth-based indentation (24px per level)
- Connector lines between parent-child relationships
- Phase-colored vertical lines showing agent phases
- Search smart-expansion: shows matching nodes and their ancestors

**Pipeline View** (lines 280-342):
- Horizontal phase flow indicator with arrow separators
- Phase cards grouped by pipeline stage
- 3-column grid layout for agent cards within phases
- Filtered agent display based on search query

### 6. **Interactive Features**
- **Search/Filter**: Real-time search across name, title, id, description
- **Expand/Collapse**: Toggle individual nodes or batch expand/collapse all
- **Detail View**: Click agent card to show full description and tools
- **View Toggle**: Switch between Pipeline and Hierarchy views
- **Stats Footer**: Agent counts by tier and model

### 7. **Styling & Theming**
- Uses Tailwind CSS with custom design tokens (surface, text-muted, accent, etc.)
- Dark theme colors with border and shadow effects
- Icons from lucide-react (Users, ChevronDown, ChevronRight, Cpu, etc.)
- Rounded corners (rounded-xl, rounded-2xl) and glass-morphism effects

### 8. **Data Flow**
```
Backend (server.js:3396)
  ↓ listAgents() from ~/agents directory
  ↓ AGENT_ROLES configuration
  ↓ AGENT_PIPELINE phases mapping
  ↓ Parse frontmatter (name, model, tools, description)
  ↓ Build nodes, edges, phases, stats
  ↓ Return OrgChartData
        ↓
API Endpoint (/api/org-chart)
        ↓
Client (OrgChart.tsx)
  ↓ getOrgChart() call
  ↓ State management (view, expanded, search)
  ↓ Render AgentCard components
  ↓ Display hierarchy or pipeline view
```

### 9. **Files Involved**

**Frontend:**
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/claude-hub/client/src/pages/OrgChart.tsx` - Main page component
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/claude-hub/client/src/lib/api.ts` - API client (getOrgChart, types)
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/claude-hub/client/src/App.tsx` - Route definition
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/claude-hub/client/src/components/Sidebar.tsx` - Navigation link

**Backend:**
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/claude-hub/src/server.js` - API endpoint (lines 3333-3466)
  - AGENT_PIPELINE constant (lines 3333-3370)
  - AGENT_ROLES constant (lines 3372-3394)
  - GET /api/org-chart handler (lines 3396-3466)

### 10. **Key Takeaways**
- Org Chart is a **unified view** of all 20 global agents with organizational structure
- Uses **two complementary visualization modes**: hierarchy (reporting structure) and pipeline (workflow stages)
- Data sourced from agent metadata in frontmatter + static role/pipeline configuration
- Fully interactive with search, filtering, and expandable details
- No separate org chart components—all logic contained in single OrgChart.tsx file
- Tree rendering uses recursive function with clever search-aware ancestor expansion
